adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`) always does `fetch(...)` and returns the raw `Response`. Several callers in the diff expect non-fetch response shapes: e.g. Google Calendar expects a gaxios-like `{ data }` (`const token = res?.data;` in `googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`), HubSpot expects an SDK token object (`HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` in `hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`), and Zoho integrations expect an axios response with `.data` (`tokenInfo.data...` in `zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data...` in `zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`). In sync mode these will receive a fetch `Response` (no `.data`), causing runtime failures across multiple integrations.
